final_report:
T83b final full-arc Playwright verification of the T83-Fix changes (learner-only via http://raspberrypi.local:8000/, health precheck ok, session 4781794fcf374b578e541b77e873f6eb).

RESULT: ALL ASSERTIONS PASS - A1, A2, A3, A4, A6-NEW, A7-NEW, A5, globals. Both T83 broken links are closed live.

A6-NEW (deterministic plan graph): build_plan tool_results now carry plan_diagram (flowchart TD, flowchart-v2, validated); the PLAN-GRAPH card auto-rendered in the right rail with validated badge and a rendered 6-node mermaid SVG; zero generate_mermaid calls anywhere in the captured streams. Two identical cards appeared only because the model ran build_plan twice (once unprompted); each tool_result produced exactly one card - dedup noted as minor UX follow-up.

A7-NEW (fresh check during remediation): the wrong CHECK answer graded incorrect and flipped phase to remediate with different-angle re-teaching (A4 intact). The fresh CHECK card auto-appeared exactly as designed - advance_lesson{passed_check:false} returned summary 'remediation' with an injected check_question and the UI rendered it with NO separate check-generation tool call. Caveat: gemma first tried passed_check=TRUE three times (all correctly rejected by the server guard with invalid_output) and kept teaching inline; it emitted {false} only after one explicit learner request. Mechanism deterministic once invoked; playbook compliance is the weak link - recommend an auto-inject fallback when phase=remediate has no pending check row.

A5 (correct answer advances): answering the fresh check correctly via buttons sent grade_answer -> 'graded correct', which alone triggered the server-side auto-advance (phase remediate->teach, Recursive Step done) - the model's subsequent legal advance_lesson call just continued to the next node. Post-reload UI corroboration: phase badge 'teach', four plan nodes checked, 'Winding and Unwinding' current. Bonus teaching step at the new node completed cleanly.

Globals: only favicon.ico 404 in console across the entire session; zero thought-leak markers and zero U+FFFD across all 26 bubbles. One transient server restart blip (~15s) mid-run, not counted against any assertion. No source files modified.
